inputs.52.text: 1980s Japanese theatrical anime cel animation in a gothic, aesthetic register: fine, sharp ink linework with long tapering strokes, hard-edged two-tone cel shading, hand-painted background art with dense architectural detail. A tall, slender gentleman with an elongated, elegant figure and long limbs stands half-turned on the landing of a narrow Georgian London staircase, one gloved hand resting on the dark mahogany banister, a long charcoal frock coat falling to his calves, his sharp-featured pale face half in shadow. Behind him a tall arched window with lace curtains blazes with low morning sunlight, laying long diagonal shafts across the worn stair carpet and the patterned wallpaper. Palette of deep indigo, blue-black and ink black in the shadows, warm lamp-gold in the shafts of light, a single accent of deep crimson in the carpet runner. Strong chiaroscuro, a thin rim of light tracing the figure's shoulders and hair, dust motes glittering in the beams. Wide frame from a low eye level, the figure small against the tall stairwell.
